## 2. Every element, proved twice without Jonathan

Read across: if a row has nothing outside Jonathan by 9 December, do not rest. "Their words" means the Answer and its annexes, which are judicial admissions. The defendants' own marked exhibits help on cross but are not our evidence unless we offer our own copies, so each one has a public-record twin.

| Element | Their own words | Public record (certified) | First-hand witness |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Patricia is a registered co-owner of the lot | Answer concedes the title history it pleads | Exh. B (T-52540); Exh. C recites derivation from T-52540 | Not needed: the title proves it |
| 2. Cesar's authority was limited to a class and to prior consultation | Answer ¶39 rests the sale on the 1992 SPA | Complete certified SPA (Exh. E completed from the certified copy; Def. Exh. 7) | Not needed: the document proves its own terms. Patricia on rebuttal |
| 3. Gloria was outside the class | Answer ¶¶40, 43, 44(a)(b): tenants paying rent | Their own receipts: the first in 2003 from Cesar's side, the only "Down payment" in 2005 (Def. Exh. 5); on cross, no Llamanzares paper produced | King (Exh. L), De Leon (Exh. N) on who lived there as renters, if within their knowledge |
| 4. No owner was consulted, and none ratified | On cross: Salvador S31, Princess, Erwin (the cross-examination checklist (memorandum pack, Annex E)) | Notarial registers for the deed, the confirmation and the partition, and the full Registry files: they show which persons appeared and signed, and no owner did [gathered quietly; offered on rebuttal]. Exh. G (2020): the owners' public repudiation of every post-2005 act of Cesar, before registration, which proves non-ratification outright | Patricia, on rebuttal only. Geraldine Hoppe and Marcia Ellen Keesey are principals too, but neither is available to us now. |
| 4A. Nothing any owner signed connects the power to T-52540 | Not needed: the papers speak | Exh. E ¶3 (the SPA describes only the undivided T-4497 parcel, 139,132 sq m); the deed (Exh. H, p. 1) describes "Lot 2-X-6-I-4-C (portion)" and names no title; Cesar's own Deed of Confirmation of 28 Mar 2017 (Registry file p. 16) is the only paper linking the sale to T-52540, and Exh. B shows it registered on 23 Nov 2021, after his death | None needed. Every item is a certified paper, so this point cannot be attacked as hearsay. |
| 5. The deed is outside the authority, so void | The deed itself; Answer ¶39 | Exh. H completed with p. 2 (Registry file p. 12) | Follows from 2 to 4 |
| 6. Not a buyer in good faith up to 23 Nov 2021 | Answer Annex "1" (28 May 2020) | Registry file Ref. 2025001098 p. 20 ("my property," 15 Sep 2021); Exh. G (2020 publication); CC 8563 certified record | King (11 Nov) on the 9 Jul 2021 pleading |
| 7. The partition could not be valid | Answer ¶46 puts it in issue | Exh. C (survey 8 Sep 2020); Exh. B entry; on rebuttal: Registry plan file Ref. 2025001096, DENR file, notarial registers | Engr. Mangiga, on rebuttal if needed |
| 8. Demand, refusal, fruits | Answer ¶27 (rooms rented) | Exh. J-1 (demand received 22 Aug 2025) | De Leon (2020 self-help, Exh. N) |
